rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure clearly falls under property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Wind damage from last weekend blew four shingles off back porch overhang. No interior leaks or additional damage. Estimated repair cost $400. Note: policy has $2,500 deductible, which exceeds the damage estimate.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off overhang above back porch
